text: Model WFW5620HW0: Whirlpool 27-inch front-load washer. Electrical requirements: 120 VAC, 60 Hz, 15-amp or 20-amp individual branch circuit protected with time-delay fuse or circuit breaker. Water supply pressure: 20 to 100 psi (138 to 689 kPa). Drum capacity 4.5 cu ft.

ELECTRICAL SHOCK HAZARD: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating. Failure to do so can result in death or electrical shock. Never service internal components while unit is plugged into mains voltage unless executing specific live voltage diagnostic tests.

To activate Diagnostic Test Mode on WFW5620HW0: With washer in standby (plugged in with console off), select any button except Power. Press and release in sequence: Button 1, Button 2, Button 3, Button 1, Button 2, Button 3, Button 1, Button 2, Button 3 within 8 seconds. All console LEDs will illuminate if entry is successful.

FAULT CODE F5E2: DOOR LOCK ERROR. Displayed when the ACU cannot detect the door lock switch closing, or door fails to lock after 3 attempts. Diagnostic checks: 1. Check door latch strike alignment. 2. Verify door lock harness connected at ACU connector DL3. 3. Measure lock solenoid coil resistance: pins 1 to 2 on DL3 should read 60 to 90 ohms. If coil is open or shorted, replace door latch mechanism.

FAULT CODE F7E1: DRIVE MOTOR TACHOMETER ERROR. The ACU detects no speed pulse from the motor tachometer while motor drive is commanded. Diagnostic checks: Check motor wiring harness between ACU connector M1 and drive motor. Inspect motor tachometer sensor: rotate drum slowly by hand and measure AC voltage across tach pins (expected 2.0 to 4.0 VAC). If no voltage generated, replace motor tachometer sensor.

FAULT CODE F8E1 (or LO FL): NO WATER FILL OR LONG FILL. Displayed if water level does not change after 10 minutes of commanded fill. Diagnostic checks: Verify home water supply valves are open. Inspect water inlet valve screen filters for sediment or calcium blockages. Test water inlet valve solenoids: resistance across coil terminals should measure 800 to 1200 ohms. Verify pressure transducer tube is secure and clear of obstructions.

FAULT CODE F9E1: LONG DRAIN / DRAIN PUMP SYSTEM. Displayed if water level does not reach empty state within 8 minutes of drain pump activation. Diagnostic checks: 1. Check drain hose for kinks or height exceeding 96 inches (2.4 m). 2. Remove lower front service panel and inspect drain pump filter/coin trap for foreign object obstructions (coins, hairpins, debris). 3. Measure drain pump motor resistance across connector DP2: should read 12 to 18 ohms. Replace pump if winding is open.

ACU DIAGNOSTIC LED BEHAVIOR: Located on the main Appliance Control Unit circuit board. Steady 1-Hz heartbeat blink indicates normal microprocessor firmware operation. Fast rapid flashing (4-Hz) indicates active communication error on serial bus. LED OFF indicates 12VDC/5VDC power supply failure on the ACU board; verify 120 VAC line input at connector J1.

TEST #1: ACU POWER CHECK. Unplug washer. Verify harness connector J1 is fully seated on the ACU. Plug washer in and measure AC voltage between J1-1 (Line) and J1-3 (Neutral). Expected: 108 to 132 VAC. If line voltage is present but the ACU diagnostic LED does not illuminate or respond, replace the ACU assembly.

TEST #4: DOOR LOCK MECHANISM. Pinout for DL3 connector on ACU: Pin 1 (Lock Solenoid Driver), Pin 2 (Solenoid Return), Pin 3 (Door Closed Switch Sense). With door closed, measure resistance between Pin 3 and Neutral: should read 0 ohms (closed circuit). With door open: reads infinite ohms (open circuit). If switch does not close when door is latched, replace door lock assembly.

DRAIN PUMP AND FILTER CLEANING PROCEDURE: 1. Disconnect electrical power. 2. Remove the three lower front panel mounting screws. 3. Lower the panel to expose the drain pump assembly. 4. Place a shallow pan and towel under the pump filter housing. 5. Turn the pump clean-out filter knob counterclockwise to remove. Clean debris, flush filter with clean water, inspect impeller for free rotation, and reinstall filter securely.

WIRING AND GROUNDING CHECK: Ensure green chassis ground wire is securely fastened to the cabinet base with specified torque (25 in-lbs). High voltage mains connections route from power cord strain relief to RFI noise filter, then to connector J1 on ACU. Never bypass RFI filter.

Model GTW685BSLWS: GE Appliances Top-Load Washer with Infusor wash system. Electrical rating: 120 VAC, 60 Hz, 10 Amps. Direct-drive motor with electronic inverter control board. Digital rotary cycle selector.

WARNING: DISCONNECT POWER BEFORE SERVICING. High voltage exists behind front and rear service panels. Always disconnect electrical power supply before touching internal components, motor, capacitor, or electronic control board.

ENTERING SERVICE MODE ON GTW685BSLWS: With washer in standby, press and hold the Start/Pause button while rotating the Cycle Selector knob seven (7) clicks clockwise, then one (1) click counter-clockwise, then release Start. All console display LEDs will flash when entered.

FAULT 16: LID SWITCH OPEN DURING CYCLE. The lid lock mechanism reported an open status while the spin cycle was commanded. Test lid lock solenoid resistance (85 to 110 ohms) at harness connector J512 on main control board. FAULT 18: DRAIN PUMP TIMEOUT. Water failed to pump out within 5 minutes. Check drain hose for restrictions and test drain pump motor winding (10.5 to 14.5 ohms).

FAULT 23: WATER TEMPERATURE SENSOR FAULT. Thermistor resistance out of specification. Expected 10k ohms at 77 deg F (25 deg C). FAULT 26: DRIVE MOTOR OVERHEAT / OVERLOAD. Motor thermal protector tripped. Check drum for mechanical jamming between basket and tub. Allow 30 minutes for thermal switch to reset.

WATER VALVE SOLENOID TEST: Disconnect harness from inlet valve. Measure resistance across each valve solenoid coil (Cold, Hot, Fabric Softener). Normal reading is 1.0 to 1.3 k-ohms (1000 to 1300 ohms). An open circuit (infinite resistance) indicates a blown solenoid coil requiring valve replacement.

MODE SHIFTER AND CLUTCH MECHANISM: The mode shifter engages the agitator or full basket spin. Resistance of the mode shifter cam actuator coil is approximately 32 ohms. Verify optical speed sensor disc is clean and free of oil or grease contamination.

Model WAT28400UC: Bosch 300 Series 24-inch Front-Load Compact Washer. Rated 208-240 VAC, 60 Hz, 12 Amps (NEMA 6-15 plug). EcoSilence drive brushless motor. EcoSilence drum suspension system with anti-vibration circular side walls.

DANGER: HIGH VOLTAGE. This appliance operates on 208-240 VAC. Always isolate mains power supply before removing top panel or rear access cover. Do not perform live diagnostics without an isolation transformer. Ensure earth bonding ground wire is secured.

SERVICE PROGRAM ENTRY FOR WAT28400UC: 1. Close door and turn program selector knob to Off (position 0). 2. Press and hold Start/Pause button while turning knob clockwise 1 position to Spin/Drain. 3. Continue holding Start/Pause until display shows P1:Errors. Release Start/Pause.

section: Error Codes: E01 / F01 & E18 / F18
text: ERROR CODE E01 (F01): DOOR LOCK ERROR. Door not locked properly. Check door latch mechanism, door hinge alignment, and wiring to triac driver on main power control module. ERROR CODE E18 (F18): DRAIN TIME EXCEEDED / PUMP BLOCKED. Washer fails to pump out water within timeout. Clean coin trap / lint filter located behind lower right round access door. Verify drain pump impeller rotates with magnetic detent feel.

section: Error Codes: E23 / F23 & E29 / F29
text: ERROR CODE E23 (F23): AQUASTOP LEAK DETECTED. The float switch in the bottom drip tray has activated due to water accumulation. Disconnect power. Inspect internal water hoses, dispenser housing, and tub gasket for leaks. Dry base tray to reset float switch. ERROR CODE E29 (F29): WATER INTAKE TIMEOUT. Low water pressure or inlet filter clogged. Test AquaStop inlet valve solenoid resistance: should measure approximately 2.0 k-ohms.

HEATING ELEMENT AND TEMPERATURE SENSOR (NTC): The internal water heating element is located at the bottom of the outer tub. Heating element resistance: 24 to 32 ohms across terminals. NTC temperature sensor resistance: approximately 20k ohms at 68 deg F (20 deg C), 6k ohms at 122 deg F (50 deg C). If heating element resistance is infinite, replace heating element.

ECOSILENCE INVERTER DRIVE MOTOR: Three-phase brushless permanent magnet motor. Measure winding resistance across motor terminals (U-V, V-W, U-W): each pair should measure identically at 5.5 to 6.5 ohms. If any phase shows open or imbalanced resistance, replace motor assembly.
